title: Miso eggs with aubergine
summary: Miso eggs with aubergine is a japanese dinner built around medium eggs and aubergines, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Miso eggs with aubergine. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add medium eggs and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and aubergines.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until rice miso paste is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Miso eggs with aubergine before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Miso eggs with aubergine.
